name: 飞书私聊（我的账号）
description: 收别人发给你本人的飞书 / Lark 私聊（可选群里 @ 你和参与过的话题），变成 Gerdr 事件；回复以你本人的身份发出。用官方 lark-cli 的个人登录（--as user）轮询。

emits.title: 飞书有人私聊我
emits.description: 别人在飞书 / Lark 私聊你本人

emits.title: 飞书群里 @ 了我
emits.description: 群里有人 @ 你（要在设置里打开「群里 @ 我也收」）

emits.title: 飞书我参与的话题有人回话
emits.description: 群里你被 @ 过或回复过的话题，之后别人不 @ 你的回话

emits.title: 飞书指定群的机器人消息
emits.description: 接收插件设置中指定的飞书 / Lark 群里新发出的机器人消息

emits.title: 飞书 CLI 登录失效
emits.description: lark-cli 的个人登录过期或缺少 IM 权限，需要你在终端跑 lark-cli auth login --domain im

settings.title: 多久查一次
settings.description: 轮询新消息的间隔。越短越及时，调用频率也越高。

settings.title: 群里 @ 我也收
settings.description: 打开后群里有人 @ 你发成 feishu-me/mention（需要 search:message 权限）。

settings.title: 参与过的话题也收
settings.description: 群里你被 @ 过或回复过的话题，之后别人不 @ 你的回话发成 feishu-me/thread（key 和 @ 你那条相同）。

settings.title: 接收机器人消息的群
settings.description: 填飞书群 ID（oc_…），多个群用逗号分隔。空着时关闭。每个群只接收启用后的新消息。

settings.title: 跳过免打扰对话
settings.description: 打开后忽略你设为免打扰的单聊会话（走会话列表模式时生效）。

settings.title: 只收这些人的消息
settings.description: 飞书用户的 open_id（ou_…），逗号分隔。空着 = 谁的都收。消息内容会交给 agent，拿不准别全放开。

settings.title: 附件大小上限
settings.description: 消息里的图片、文件下到本机，路径放进事件。0 = 不下。

settings.title: lark-cli 配置名（profile）
settings.description: 空着 = 用 lark-cli 当前默认配置。同时用国内飞书和国际版 Lark 时，填 lark-cli profile list 里的名字。

settings.title: lark-cli 路径
settings.description: 空着 = 在 PATH、/opt/homebrew/bin、/usr/local/bin 和 version-fox / nvm 装的 node 里找。

en.name: Feishu / Lark DMs (My Account)
en.description: Messages people send you on Feishu / Lark (direct messages, optionally @-mentions and threads you joined) become Gerdr events; replies are sent as you. Polls using the official lark-cli signed in as you (--as user).

interval.title: Check every
interval.description: How often to poll for new messages.

mentions.title: Group @-mentions too
mentions.description: Group messages mentioning you become feishu-me/mention (needs search:message scope).

threads.title: Threads you're in too
threads.description: Follow-ups without @ in group threads you were @-mentioned in or replied to become feishu-me/thread (same key as the @-mention).

botChats.title: Groups to receive bot messages from
botChats.description: Comma-separated Feishu / Lark chat IDs (oc_…). Leave empty to disable. Each group starts with new messages after it is enabled.

excludeMuted.title: Skip muted chats
excludeMuted.description: Ignore direct-message chats you muted (applies when polling via chat list).

allow.title: Only from these people
allow.description: Feishu / Lark open_ids (ou_…), comma separated. Empty = everyone.

maxFileMB.title: Attachment size limit
maxFileMB.description: Images and files in a message are downloaded and their paths put in the event. 0 = don't.

profile.title: lark-cli profile
profile.description: Empty = default profile. Set a profile name from `lark-cli profile list` if you use both Feishu and Lark.

larkCli.title: lark-cli path
larkCli.description: Empty = look on PATH, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin and in version-fox / nvm node installs.
